name: baton
question: What is left of an orchestrator once Claude Code builds in what it added?
body: baton spent seven versions as a multi-agent orchestrator for Claude Code: a lead that only hands out work, model ladders, expert reviewers, team runs on GitHub, a mod with a memory. Its own experiments, and Claude Code catching up, cut it down to the one part worth keeping: a status line with your 5-hour, Fable, weekly and context usage, reset times in your own time zone, and n/a instead of a guess. A shell script on macOS and Linux, PowerShell on Windows; no plugin, no Node. Its page tells each version's story and why it went.
alt: baton v8 — the four parts of its status line under a Claude Code prompt: 5h at 19% resetting 14:30 EST, fable at 0%, wk at 54% resetting Mon 07:00 EST, and ctx at 5%
